international.title: Australia, UK, Canada and Italy urge Israel to allow critical aid to Gaza ahead of winter
international.summary: Four countries call situation ‘entirely reversible’ in joint statement as flooding exacerbates humanitarian crisis Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom and Italy have urged Israel to allow critical humanitarian aid to enter Gaza, describing the situation on the ground as “dire”. The four countries released a joint statement on Monday morning, urging Israel to allow 150,000 tents and other vital supplies being held at the border into Gaza ahead of winter. Continue reading...
